1. the setting and the essay question (source): opening The Olympic Games is no doubt the most grand and prevalent sporting event on this planet., closing In this essay, we mainly discussed the methods of utilizing limited data, predicting the countries’ performance in 2028, honoring the coaches and predicting future numbers based on the effect of potential great coaches., so the Games as the most prevalent event, the medal counts as dedication and development, the coaches hidden behind the numbers and the four questions of limited data, the 2028 forecast, honoring coaches and projecting coach effects, fill one block of 81 words.

2. Model I opens (compute): opening In model I, we predicted the number of events in every discipline at the 2028 Games., closing We first preprocessed the data, grouping the players by their teams and countries., so Model I on the 2028 event count per discipline and the preprocessing that groups players by team and country fill one block of 28 words.

3. Models I and II, the SVR and the XGBoost (compute): opening We chose to analyze the data on disciplines, summing up their events since events in the same discipline are similar and tend to develop simultaneously, also avoiding overgeneralizing to the level of sports., closing The 95% confidence intervals were calculated for 9 typical countries, and all predicted results lied in the intervals, proving high reliability., so the discipline-level series, the SVR over linear regression with an MSE of 1.744 and an R-squared of 0.634, the rose plots, the LSTM baseline with the Adam optimizer, the plateau scheduler and the punishment terms, the failed plain LSTM and the switch to XGBoost on medal fractions, the 90 percent host improvement averaged at 15 percent, and the American 47 golds, 45 silvers and 36 bronzes against the Chinese 35, 24 and 15 and the Japanese 18, 9 and 10, with the 95 percent intervals over nine countries, fill one block of 257 words.

4. Model III and the three debutants (compute): opening In Model III, we addressed the cases where a country that had never earned an Olympic medal earned its first at 2028., closing 3 is the most likely with probability 22.73%, and the three most likely first-time medalists are Monaco, Liechtenstein and Myanmar., so the Cox proportional hazard model with the risk function for the switch from no medal to first medal, the Monte Carlo runs and the three first-time medallists as the likeliest count at 22.73 percent, with Monaco, Liechtenstein and Myanmar named, fill one block of 88 words.

5. Model IV and the three coach picks (compute): opening In Model IV, we addressed the Great Coach Effect (GCE)., closing We predicted that CHN Archery would go from 2 in 2024 to 7 in 2028, USA Taekwondo from 5 to 8, and TPE Swimming from 0 to 9, after hiring great coaches., so the Threshold Method over the first-order difference and ratio of the weighted score, the Isolation Forest cross-check with the 3, 2 and 1 weights at an 89 percent agreement, the OR logic over the two thresholds, the American taekwondo, Chinese archery and Taiwanese swimming picks, and the projections from 2 to 7, 5 to 8 and 0 to 9 medals, fill one block of 186 words.

6. the gender study and the validation (handoff): opening Finally, we looked into the male-female score ratio to provide insights on gender-equality since data showed that the stronger countries are more gender-balanced., closing Meanwhile, strengths and weaknesses of the models were analyzed, insights were visualized and discussed, and sensitivity analysis was done., so the male-female score ratio as a gender-equality insight, the visualization of predictions, fitted lines, forests and coach effects, and the closing note on strengths, weaknesses, insights and sensitivity fill one block of 61 words.
